key_phrases: 3P sellers provided 56% of all unit sales
analysis.reasoning: The company shows strong top-line growth, particularly in AWS (40% YoY) and third-party seller integration. Management demonstrated high transparency regarding significant cost headwinds ($4B+) from inflation and labor shortages due to Omicron. While near-term operating margins are pressured by decreased leverage and rising wages, the announcement of a Prime price increase signals strong pricing power. The QA session was highly specific with detailed CapEx breakdowns, showing low evasion.
